goal.title: All 17 fields: walk to field + gather + walk home, Natro 1:1
goal.summary: All 17 path-out routes pass 3/3. The movement engine copies Natro's cannon and hive-finding code exactly. The laptop is running the full loop (walk out, gather, walk home, convert) field by field on that engine: Mountain Top and Spider are done 3/3 so far. Other walk-home scores are from earlier today and get replaced as the run reaches each field.

routes_note: Live tests on the laptop, latest update 11:08 PM PT. “Full loop” means walk to the field, gather, walk home, and convert. None of these numbers are invented.
